title: EmailDelivery
description: One request to email the invoice PDF to a recipient the user confirmed. A resend is a new delivery. A delivery is attempted once; the server never retries it. A failed delivery does not change the booking, the payment, or the invoice.

sequence.description: Order of the request for this invoice, starting at 1.

status.description: pending: queued or being sent. sent: the provider accepted the message. failed: the provider refused it or could not be reached.

provider.description: Provider that handled the attempt. Null until the worker picks the delivery up.

error_code.description: Safe code such as EMAIL_PROVIDER_UNREACHABLE. Provider messages and credentials are never stored.

attachment_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the PDF bytes that were attached. Set once the PDF was read back and checked, before the provider is called.
